description: CsKNa₂Li₁₂(SiO₄)₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/m space group. Cs is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All Cs-O bond lengths are 3.11 Å. K is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.87 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.51 Å) and four longer (2.74 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.51 Å) and four longer (2.74 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.07 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.34 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.07 Å. In the fourth Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.34 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.67 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cs, one K, three Li, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, three Li, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Li₃Si octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, three Li, and one Si atom.
